newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Novo to get Showa patents.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Novo to get Showa patents.

text.p: Danish biotech group Novo Nordisk said on Tuesday that it was about to acquire enzyme patents and know-how from Japanese chemical manufacturer Showa Denko.
"This deal will improve Novo Nordisk's position within some of our core enzyme technologies," Novo executive vice president of enzyme business Steen Riisgaard said in a statement.
The statement added that the world market for industrial enzymes grew 15 percent to $1.3 billion in 1995, compared to 1994. It did not give financial details of the Showa agreement.
Showa was pulling out of the enzyme field, Novo said.

Novo has also increased the number of original patents it has applied for to around 200 in 1995 from half that number the year before as a result of increased focus on core areas and a tendency in the industry as a whole toward more aggressive patenting. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969650
